review.notes: Full read-through of all OCR lines against extracted text from all 30 physical PDF pages; pages 15, 25 and 26 were additionally rendered and visually inspected. Structural repair dominates this document: OCR promoted Figure 10 grid column headers (physical p.15, rendered and confirmed as repeated per-row-block column labels, not sections) and all ten generated-slide titles of the Figure 19 gallery (physical p.26, rendered and confirmed to exist only inside the slide images) to '##' headings, which would inject about sixteen bogus sections into the reader outline; all are demoted to plain text with content preserved. The Figure 19 caption prints at the bottom of p.26 below the slide grid, but OCR placed it mid-gallery before the last slide block; two patches move the caption text after the final slide transcription without touching any image embed. Reference URL escape seedream5\_0\_lite verified against the p.29 text layer. Figure-internal diagram labels on p.8 (pipeline stage boxes such as '[S1 256p] ... Filter') exist only inside the Figure 6 vector diagram and are correctly absent from OCR prose. The notation tokens Pfine/Pshort/sfake/sreal flagged by word-diffusion are present in OCR as $P_{fine}$, $s_{\mathrm{fake}}$ math; section 4.3 including equations (4)-(5) is complete. Reference list balance checked (27 OCR entries vs 26 PDF entries with arXiv lines; one printed entry cites without arXiv). No spaced-digit or dropped-sentence defects found in the prose or tables.
